question: hej! vi är ett litet ai-bolag i gbg med 4 anställda och håller på med FoU typ hela tiden. hörde att man kan få forskningsavdrag på arbetsgivaravgiften?? kan vi dra av för alla fyra? måste man ansöka nånstans innan eller fyller man bara i det på AGI:n? och ungefär hur mkt blir det
material: Löner per månad: Johan (vd, grundare) 48 000, Sara (cto, medgrundare) 52 000, Ali (ML-ingenjör) 50 000, Mei (data engineer) 46 000. Alla jobbar heltid. Vi bygger en egen modell som förutsäger läckor och fel i fjärrvärmenät utifrån sensordata, två betalande pilotkunder.
hidden_profile: Country: Sweden (Göteborg). Legal form and registration: aktiebolag, registered at Bolagsverket 2022-09-12; registered as employer since 2023-01. Headcount and salaries: 4 employees, all full time (about 165 h/month), aged 29-44: Johan Lind, founder and CEO, 48,000 SEK/month, spends about 20% of his time on model work and the rest on sales, investors, board work and admin; Sara Ek, co-founder and CTO, 52,000 SEK, about 90% hands-on model research; Ali Haddad, ML engineer, 50,000 SEK, 100% R&D; Mei Chen, data engineer, 46,000 SEK, about 80% on the training and feature pipeline and 20% on customer integrations. Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 net turnover 1.6 MSEK from two pilot contracts with energy companies; balance sheet total 4.2 MSEK. Ownership: Johan 45%, Sara 35%, Chalmers Ventures AB 8%, two business angels 6% each. Public grants and loans: Vinnova Innovativa startups 2023, 300,000 SEK, finished 2024; no loans. De minimis: none recorded. Outside jobs and university links: Sara took her PhD at Chalmers in 2021 and has no current position; nobody has an outside job. Work started or ordered: R&D has run since 2023 with written project plans and time reports per person in Jira; they have never claimed forskningsavdrag, AGI boxes 470 and 475 have always been empty. Share capital and losses: share capital 25,000 SEK; equity 1.9 MSEK after a 2024 share issue; accumulated losses 2.3 MSEK. Data: sensor time series from two district-heating customers under data-sharing agreements, no personal data. Deadline: the accounting firm wants an answer by 15 November 2026 so it can start with the November AGI, due 12 December 2026. Real goal: cut payroll cost to stretch runway to a seed round in mid-2027. Fit: fits fully for Sara, Ali and Mei; Johan does not qualify.
trap: Johan, the CEO, spends about 20% of his time on R&D and the rest on management, sales and admin. Skatteverket requires that the person works at least 50% of working time on R&D and at least 15 hours in the calendar month, and excludes staff in 'ledning och styrning' and marketing, so his salary cannot be in the base in ruta 470. The deduction is 20% of the base: 20% of 148,000 SEK = 29,600 SEK a month for Sara, Ali and Mei, not 39,200 SEK for all four. The company must itself keep documentation per person (time reports, project plans). https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html

question:
hej! ska söka Vinnovas Innovativa startups nu i höst (stänger 12 jan va?). kan du hjälpa mig skriva ansökan? här är vad vi har:

Bolag: Klarvy AB, Uppsala
Idé: AI som läser upphandlingsunderlag och flaggar ska-krav som små leverantörer missar, typ en kvalificeringsassistent. 6 betalande pilotkunder (bygg- och IT-konsulter)
Team: jag (Linnea, vd, 100%), Oskar (cto, 100%), Amir (fullstack, 80%)
Budget (utkast):
- löner Linnea+Oskar 9 mån: 540 000
- konsult ML-ops (Nordiq Data AB): 150 000
- juristgranskning av LOU-tolkningar: 40 000
- resor kundbesök: 15 000
Söker 500k. vad saknas? kan du skriva projektbeskrivningen och varför vi behöver finansieringen?
material: Löner/mån: Linnea 38 000, Oskar 40 000, Amir 42 000 (heltidslön, jobbar 80%). Oskar är tänkt projektledare. Omsättning 2025: 420 000 kr. Pilotkunderna betalar 1 500-4 000 kr/mån. Nordiq Data ska sätta upp träningspipeline och övervakning av modellen. Mål 2027: 40 betalande kunder och en seedrunda.
hidden_profile: Country: Sweden (Uppsala). Legal form and registration: aktiebolag, registered at Bolagsverket 2023-02-14, so 4 years 1 month old on Vinnova's decision date 23 March 2027; registered as employer since 2023-06; not part of a group, not listed, has never merged or taken over a business. Headcount and salaries: 2.8 FTE: Linnea (CEO) 38,000 SEK/month, Oskar (CTO, the intended project leader, employed by the company) 40,000 SEK/month, Amir 80% of a 42,000 SEK full-time salary; no profit has ever been distributed. Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 net turnover 0.42 MSEK, balance sheet total 1.9 MSEK. Ownership: Linnea 41%, Oskar 37%, Amir 4%, Uppsala universitet Holding AB 6%, three angels 12% together. Public grants and loans: Region Uppsala innovationscheck 2024, 100,000 SEK; no Vinnova grants; did not apply to Innovativa startups 2025. De minimis: the 2024 innovationscheck, 100,000 SEK. Outside jobs and university links: Oskar left a PhD position at Uppsala University in 2023 and has no current position; Amir freelances 20% for a web agency. Work started or ordered: on 2026-09-28 they signed an order with Nordiq Data AB for the ML-ops work in the draft budget, 150,000 SEK, running 2026-11-01 to 2027-01-31 with invoices from December 2026. Share capital and losses: share capital 25,000 SEK, share premium paid in 1.4 MSEK, accumulated losses 0.85 MSEK, equity about 0.58 MSEK. Data: public procurement documents (TED and Swedish procurement databases) plus customers' own tender submissions under a data processing agreement; personal data only as contact names in tenders. Deadline: the call closes 12 January 2027 at 14:00; they want to submit before Christmas; runway until August 2027. Real goal: fund customer validation and model accuracy work in 2027 and show traction for a seed round. Fit: fits fully.
trap: The ML-ops consultancy (150,000 SEK) is already ordered and runs November 2026 to January 2027, but Vinnova decides on 23 March 2027, the project can start 23-24 March 2027 at the earliest (1 April 2027 at the latest) and may run at most nine months. Work done before the project starts is not a project cost, so that budget line must go or be replaced by work inside the project period. Everything else meets the listed requirements (Swedish AB under 10 years, under 10 FTE, under SEK 10 million, no dividends, no 2025 grant, project leader employed, less than half the share capital consumed). https://www.vinnova.se/en/calls-for-proposals/innovative-startups/innovative-startups-2026

question: hej! vi är en startup i linköping som tränar en egen visionmodell för att hitta defekter i gjutgods. behöver typ 20-30k gpu-timmar. kan vi söka beräkningstid via SNIC? tänkte Berzelius eller Alvis. vad krävs, kostar det nåt och hur lång tid tar det innan man får tillgång?
material: Vi är 5 pers: Viktor (vd), Hanna (cto), Amanda (ml) och två utvecklare. Tränar idag på hyrda moln-GPU:er för ca 60k/mån. Modellen ska klassa röntgen- och kamerabilder från gjuteriets produktionslina, v2 ska levereras i mars.
hidden_profile: Country: Sweden (Linköping). Legal form and registration: aktiebolag, registered 2024-05-20. Headcount and salaries: 5 employees, all salaried: CEO Viktor 40,000 SEK/month, CTO Hanna 42,000 SEK, ML engineer Amanda 38,000 SEK, two developers 36,000 SEK each. Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 net turnover 0.9 MSEK (paid pilot with a foundry), balance sheet total 3.1 MSEK. Ownership: Viktor 25%, Hanna 25%, Amanda 25%, LiU Holding (Linköping University) 5%, angel syndicate 20%. Public grants and loans: Vinnova Innovativa startups 2024, 300,000 SEK, finished 2025; no loans. De minimis: none. Outside jobs and university links: Hanna left her postdoc at Linköping University in December 2025; nobody in the company holds an appointment at a Swedish university or research institute, and nobody is a doctoral student. Work started or ordered: training on rented cloud GPUs at about 60,000 SEK a month since spring 2026. Share capital and losses: share capital 25,000 SEK, accumulated losses 1.4 MSEK, equity 1.8 MSEK. Data: about 400,000 X-ray and camera images from the customer's foundry under NDA, proprietary. Deadline: wants compute from January 2027 to deliver model v2 to the foundry by end of March 2027. Real goal: cut GPU cost. Fit: closed.
trap: NAISS, which replaced SNIC, gives compute free of charge only to researchers at Swedish universities and research institutes: the Small round requires a scientist in Swedish academia at least at doctoral-student level, the Medium and LUMI rounds at least assistant professor. Nobody in the company holds such a position and a company cannot be the applicant, so the program is closed to them. Alvis is also closed to new allocations because it is being decommissioned. https://www.naiss.se/allocations/ and https://supr.naiss.se/round/2026small/

question: Tja! funderar på att söka Almis innovationslån, 500 lax, för att bygga klart prototypen (ml-styrd bevattning för växthus). vad behöver vi ha redo? krävs personlig borgen? och hur snabbt brukar man få besked
material: Team: Elsa (vd) och Kim (tech), båda anställda sedan jan 2026. Prototyp v1 rullar i tre testväxthus. v2: ny sensorbox, egen styrenhet, modell som optimerar bevattning per zon. Vill köra betald pilot våren 2027.
hidden_profile: Country: Sweden (Malmö). Legal form and registration: aktiebolag, registered 2024-10-01, well under 249 employees. Headcount and salaries: the two founders, Elsa (CEO) and Kim (tech), employed since January 2026 at 30,000 SEK/month each. Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 net turnover 0.12 MSEK (paid test installations), balance sheet total 0.9 MSEK. Ownership: Elsa 45%, Kim 45%, one business angel 10%. Public grants and loans: Region Skåne innovationscheck 2025, 100,000 SEK; no loans. De minimis: the 2025 innovationscheck, 100,000 SEK. Outside jobs and university links: Kim works 20% as a lab engineer at Lund University; Elsa has no outside job. Work started or ordered: prototype v1 runs in three test greenhouses; nothing for v2 is ordered. Project budget: the full v2 project costs 800,000 SEK: hardware 220,000, external electronics design 180,000, the founders' own work 300,000, field tests 100,000; co-financing available is the angel's 200,000 SEK in the bank plus the founders' work. Both founders accept a limited personal guarantee. Share capital and losses: share capital 25,000 SEK, share premium 400,000 SEK from the founders (2024) and 200,000 SEK from the angel (paid in August 2026), accumulated losses 0.3 MSEK, equity about 0.33 MSEK. Data: own sensor and yield data from the three test greenhouses. Deadline: wants the money by February 2027, before the growing season. Real goal: finish v2 and run a paid pilot in spring 2027. Fit: fits fully, for up to 400,000 SEK.
trap: The whole v2 project costs 800,000 SEK and Almi finances at most 50% of the project cost, so the loan can be at most 400,000 SEK, not 500,000. At 400,000 SEK (above 300,000) at least half of the co-financing must be capital such as equity, bank financing or other external funding: 200,000 SEK, which the angel money just covers; the rest can be their own work. https://www.almi.se/en/loan/innovation-loan/

program: EIC Accelerator (the old SME instrument phase 2)
question:
Hi! we got a GO on our EIC short proposal last month (basically the old SME instrument phase 2) and now need to write the full application for the Nov 4 cutoff. can you help draft the impact + implementation parts? here's our stuff:

Fjordline Robotics - autonomous hull inspection drones for ships, replaces divers and drydock inspections
TRL 6, sea trials w a ferry operator + Port of Gothenburg
Ask: 2.4M EUR grant + 6M EUR equity
Budget 24 mo: personnel 1.9M, subcontracting (class society certification) 450k, equipment 380k, other 200k, total ~3.4M
Team: Elin (CEO, ex-defence industry), Marco (CTO, PhD robotics KTH), Jonas (COO), 11 employees in Gothenburg
Revenue 2025: ~0.8M EUR (inspection-as-a-service pilots)

we dont have market sizing or a risk table yet. deadline is tight so pls be quick
material: Market: about 60k merchant ships over 5,000 GT need hull inspections roughly every 2.5 years; we guess a 1.2B EUR/yr inspection market. Pilot customers: 2 ferry operators, 1 tanker company. Cap table: founders 64%, Y Combinator 7%, Nordic seed fund 18%, angels 6%, ESOP 5%. Seed round 3.5M USD in 2025. Hiring plan: +12 FTE over 24 months (robotics, ML, certification).
hidden_profile: Country: Sweden (Gothenburg) for all operations; parent company in the USA. Legal form and registration: Fjordline Robotics Inc., a Delaware C-corporation incorporated 2025-03-03 in a flip during Y Combinator, owns 100% of Fjordline Robotics AB (registered at Bolagsverket 2021-08-16). The short proposal that got the GO on 2026-09-24 was submitted with the Delaware Inc. as the applicant legal entity (its PIC in the Funding & Tenders Portal). Headcount and salaries: 14 people, all employed and paid by the AB (55,000-75,000 SEK/month including the founders); the Inc. has no staff. Revenue and balance sheet: AB 2025 net turnover 8.9 MSEK (about 0.8M EUR); group balance sheet total about 4.1M EUR. Ownership: (of the Inc.) Elin 28%, Marco 24%, Jonas 12%, Y Combinator 7%, a Nordic seed fund 18%, angels 6%, option pool 5%. Public grants and loans: the AB had a Vinnova grant (Innovationsprojekt i företag) of 2.0 MSEK in 2023-2024 and an Almi innovationslån of 0.5 MSEK in 2022, repaid 2025. De minimis: none in the last three years. Outside jobs and university links: Marco is an unpaid affiliated researcher at KTH; all IP was assigned from the AB to the Inc. in the 2025 flip. Work started or ordered: sea trials ongoing; the class certification is not yet ordered. Share capital and losses: AB share capital 50,000 SEK; group accumulated losses about 2.6M EUR; equity positive after the 2025 round. Data: hull imagery from sea trials owned by the company, plus ship-owner data under pilot agreements. Deadline: full-proposal cut-off 4 November 2026 at 17:00 Brussels time; the EIC page lists no 2027 cut-offs yet; runway 14 months. Real goal: EIC grant plus equity to fund certification and scale-up; the US investors do not want to undo the Delaware structure. Fit: conditional.
trap: The applicant entity behind the GO is the Delaware Inc., a third-country company. EIC Accelerator applicants must come from an EU Member State or a country associated to Horizon Europe, and a third-country applicant may relocate only before submitting the full application (Step 2). Unless the applicant becomes an EU-established entity before the 4 November 2026 full proposal, they cannot submit, and no 2027 cut-off is published yet. https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-funding-opportunities/eic-accelerator_en

question: Moi! voisko meidän firma hakea Business Findlandin Tempo-rahoitusta? se 50k avustus startupeille. tehään satelliittidatasta metsätuhojen tunnistusta AI:lla. mitä pitää olla valmiina ja kauanko käsittely kestää? olis kiva saada päätös vielä tän vuoden puolella
material: Tiimi: Aino (CEO) ja Mikko (CTO) kokoaikaisina, 2 osa-aikaista ML-devaajaa. Liikevaihto 2025 n. 140k€. Tarve n. 100k€ SAR-pohjaiseen tuhontunnistukseen ja Ruotsin laajentumiseen. Pilottiasiakkaana metsänhoitoyhdistys.
hidden_profile: Country: Finland (Espoo). Legal form and registration: osakeyhtiö, registered in the Trade Register 2023-03-15 (3 years 7 months old). Headcount and salaries: CEO Aino and CTO Mikko full time at 3,800 EUR/month each; two ML developers at 50% (Aalto master's students), 2,000 EUR/month each. Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 revenue 140,000 EUR (pilot with a forest owners' association), balance sheet total 410,000 EUR. Ownership: Aino 40%, Mikko 40%, two angels 15% together, option pool 5%. Public grants and loans: accepted into ESA BIC Finland in February 2025 and received its 50,000 EUR incubation funding in 2025; no other public grants or loans, no earlier Business Finland money. De minimis: the 50,000 EUR ESA BIC funding (2025). Outside jobs and university links: Mikko finished his PhD at Aalto in 2023 and holds no position; the two developers study at Aalto. Work started or ordered: product in pilot use; nothing new ordered. Share capital and losses: share capital 2,500 EUR, invested unrestricted equity (SVOP) 320,000 EUR from a 2024 angel round, accumulated losses 120,000 EUR. Data: Sentinel-2 and licensed commercial SAR imagery plus ground-truth plots from the association. Deadline: wants a decision before end of 2026 to hire a third full-time developer in January 2027. Real goal: about 100,000 EUR for SAR-based damage detection and expansion to Sweden. Fit: closed.
trap: Tempo is closed and will not reopen; its successor is the Sprint grant (75% of a 100,000-133,334 EUR project, continuous call since 1 September 2026). A company under five years old must not have received Sprint, Tempo or equivalent funding such as ESA-BIC, nor Business Finland R&D, Young Innovative Companies or Deep Tech Accelerator funding. The 2025 ESA BIC funding therefore bars them, although they meet the other rules (Finnish Oy, small, 322,500 EUR equity financing, two committed people with one full time). https://www.businessfinland.fi/en/services/funding/calls/2026/ongoing-sprint-grant-funding/

question:
Hei, tarviisin apua TE-toimiston starttirahahakemuksen kanssa. Voitko täyttää sen mun puolesta ja lähettää? Kirjaudu mun pankkitunnuksilla suomi.fi:hin, hetu XXXXXX-XXXX, tunnukset ja vahvistuskoodin laitan sulle erikseen. Tässä liiketoimintasuunnitelma lyhyesti:

Yritys: Sanaseppä Oy, tekoälyavusteinen käännös- ja lokalisointipalvelu pk-yrityksille (suomi-ruotsi-englanti)
Asiakkaat: 2 pilottiasiakasta, tavoite 8 maksavaa asiakasta 2027 loppuun mennessä
Hinnoittelu: kk-maksu 290-900 €
Aloituskustannukset: läppäri 1 800 €, ohjelmistolisenssit 120 €/kk, kirjanpito 150 €/kk
Rahoitus: omat säästöt 6 000 €

Kannattavuuslaskelma puuttuu vielä, voitko tehdä senkin? ja CV pitäis kai liittää?
material: Laura Virtanen, FM (Helsingin yliopisto 2017), 8 vuotta kääntäjänä ohjelmistoyrityksessä. Pilottiasiakkaat: helsinkiläinen SaaS-yritys ja turkulainen verkkokauppa. Arvioitu liikevaihto 1. vuonna 28 000 €. Asun Helsingissä.
hidden_profile: Country: Finland (lives in Helsinki; Helsinki employment area). Legal form and registration: Sanaseppä Oy, registered in the Trade Register 2026-09-04. Headcount and salaries: Laura only, no salary paid yet. Revenue and balance sheet: first invoice of 1,450 EUR sent 2026-09-30 to a pilot customer, second of 900 EUR on 2026-10-15; balance sheet about 7,000 EUR. Ownership: Laura 100%. Public grants and loans: none; has never had starttiraha. De minimis: none. Outside jobs and university links: her job as in-house translator at a software company ended 2026-08-31; MA University of Helsinki 2017, no current link. Work started or ordered: she has worked full time in the company since 1 September 2026; pilots are delivered and invoiced. Share capital and losses: share capital 0 EUR; 6,000 EUR of savings put into SVOP; small loss so far. Data: customers' documents under NDA, run through a commercial machine-translation API; no model training. Deadline: savings last until end of December 2026. Real goal: a living income for the first 6-12 months. Fit: closed.
trap: Starttiraha is not granted if the business started before the application was submitted; the application must come before full-time business begins. Laura has worked full time in the Oy since 1 September 2026 and invoiced customers, so she cannot get it. It is applied for from the regional employment authority (here the City of Helsinki), not a TE office. https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/nama-5-asiaa-sinun-tulee-tietaa-starttirahasta and https://tyomarkkinatori.fi/uutiset/starttiraha-tukee-yrittajyyden-alkua

question: Hei! saisko meidän startup ilmasta GPU-aikaa LUMI:lta sen AI Factoryn kautta? tarvittais n. 30 000 GPU-tuntia suomenkielisen puhemallin fine-tuneen. mitä hakemukseen tarvii ja kuinka nopeesti pääsee alkuun? pari meidän tyyppiä on käyttäny LUMIa väikkärin aikana joten slurm on tuttu
material: Puhekaari Oy, Tampere. 12 henkeä. Malli: suomenkielinen puheentunnistus ja -synteesi suoratoistopalveluun. Data: n. 8 000 h lisensoitua yleisradiopuhetta + Common Voice. Tarve: 30 000 GPU-tuntia yhdellä koneella, 2-3 kk.
hidden_profile: Country: Finland (Tampere). Legal form and registration: Puhekaari Oy, registered in the Trade Register 2024-01-10. Headcount and salaries: 12 employees, all salaried. Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 revenue 0.9M EUR, balance sheet total 2.2M EUR. Ownership: 100% owned since June 2025 by Nordmedia Group Oyj, a listed Finnish media group with about 2,400 employees and 410M EUR revenue; the founders sold their shares and stay as employees on an earn-out. Public grants and loans: none. De minimis: none. Outside jobs and university links: the CTO teaches 10% as a docent at Tampere University; two engineers used LUMI during their PhDs and know Slurm. Work started or ordered: fine-tuning experiments on rented cloud GPUs since August 2026. Share capital and losses: share capital 2,500 EUR; losses covered by group contributions from the parent. Data: 8,000 hours of Finnish broadcast speech licensed from the parent's archive, plus open Common Voice data. Deadline: wants compute in December 2026 for a launch in the parent's streaming service in Q2 2027. Real goal: free compute instead of paying for cloud GPUs. Fit: closed for the free track (pay-per-use commercial access remains).
trap: Free AI Factory access in the industrial-innovation track (run by the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking, LUMI being one host) is for AI SMEs, including startups, for innovation purposes; other industrial users get pay-per-use commercial access. A firm that is part of a larger group must count the group's staff and turnover, so as a 100% subsidiary of a 2,400-person listed group Puhekaari is not an SME and cannot get free access, even though its need (30,000 GPU hours, HPC-experienced team) fits Fast Lane. https://lumi-supercomputer.eu/access-calls-for-ai-factories/ and https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/ai-factories/ai-factories-access-calls_en and https://single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu/smes/sme-fundamentals/sme-definition_en

question: Hei! Vi har drevet med utvikling av en ML-modell som forutsier lakselus i oppdrettsanlegg hele året. Har hørt at SkatteFUNN gir 20 % tilbake på alle utviklingskostnader, og at vi kan søke etter nyttår og fortsatt få fradrag for kostnadene i år? stemmer det? hva trenger vi for å søke
material: Prosjekt: modell som varsler lakselusutbrudd 2-3 uker før, basert på sjøtemperatur, strøm og telledata. 6 ansatte, ca 3,2 mill i kostnader i 2026, mest lønn. CTO har 20 % stilling ved UiB.
hidden_profile: Country: Norway (Bergen). Legal form and registration: AS registered in Brønnøysundregistrene 2021-05-18, taxable in Norway. Headcount and salaries: 6 employees on payroll, including both founders at 750,000 NOK/year each. Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 revenue 2.1 MNOK (subscriptions with three fish farmers), balance sheet total 5.4 MNOK. Ownership: founders 30% each, an angel network 25%, Vestkyst Havbruk AS (a fish farmer and customer) 15%. Public grants and loans: Innovasjon Norge oppstartstilskudd 2022, 600,000 NOK; never had SkatteFUNN. De minimis: none recorded. Outside jobs and university links: the CTO holds a 20% adjunct position (førsteamanuensis II) at the University of Bergen. Work started or ordered: the R&D project has run since January 2026, about 3.2 MNOK of costs in 2026, mostly salaries, with 2026 losses still accruing. Share capital and losses: share capital 30,000 NOK, share premium 6.0 MNOK from the 2022-2023 rounds, accumulated losses 4.1 MNOK per the 2025 accounts, total equity 1.93 MNOK. Data: sensor and lice-count data from three customers plus public data from BarentsWatch. Deadline: wants the deduction in the 2026 tax return; a board meeting on 10 November 2026 discusses a 3 MNOK share issue planned for Q1 2027. Real goal: cash from SkatteFUNN to extend runway. Fit: conditional.
trap: The AS was registered in May 2021, so it is older than three years, and per its 2025 accounts it has lost more than half its equity (paid in 6.03 MNOK, accumulated losses 4.1 MNOK, equity 1.93 MNOK). SkatteFUNN treats that as a company in difficulty: it cannot be one when the application is approved and must declare at the decision that it is not. They need enough new equity that less than half is lost at the time of approval. https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/hvem/ (On the premises: the rate is 19%, and applying after the 1 September guarantee deadline can lose the deduction for the application year, https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/sok/)

question:
Hei! Skal søke etablerertilskudd fra Innovasjon Norge (heter visst oppstartstilskudd 1 nå). Kan du skrive søknaden og sende den inn for meg? Du kan logge inn med BankID-en min, fnr XXXXXXXXXXX, jeg sender deg koden på sms. Her er det jeg har:

Tidvis - app som bruker KI til å lage vaktlister for små restauranter
Kundesamtaler: snakket med 9 restauranter i Trondheim, 5 vil teste
Budsjett:
- klikkbar prototype (frilans designer): 60 000
- min egen tid 3 mnd: 90 000
- juridisk (personvern + arbeidsmiljøloven): 25 000
- pilot med 5 restauranter: 20 000
Søker 150 000.
mangler konkurrentanalyse, kan du lage den?
material: Kari Nilsen, 31, master i industriell økonomi fra NTNU (2019), jobber som restaurantsjef. Konkurrenter jeg vet om: Planday, Quinyx, Tamigo. Pilotene skal bruke ansattes vaktønsker og salgstall fra kassesystemet.
hidden_profile: Country: Norway (Trondheim). Legal form and registration: enkeltpersonforetak 'Tidvis Kari Nilsen', registered in Brønnøysundregistrene 2025-11-03; no AS has been founded. The ENK has no customers, contracts, IP or other assets beyond the idea. Headcount and salaries: Kari alone, no salary. Revenue and balance sheet: no revenue; about 40,000 NOK of own savings in the business account. Ownership: Kari 100%. Public grants and loans: none; no SkatteFUNN. De minimis: none. Outside jobs and university links: works 60% as restaurant manager in Trondheim until December 2026; NTNU master's 2019, no current university link. Work started or ordered: nothing ordered or paid; the designer has only sent a quote. No payment remarks. Share capital and losses: no share capital (ENK); 50,000 NOK of savings set aside. Data: the pilots will process restaurant employees' shift wishes and sales data, which is personal data. Deadline: wants a decision by January 2027 to run pilots February-April 2027. Real goal: test willingness to pay before quitting her job. Fit: conditional.
trap: The business is an enkeltpersonforetak. Oppstartstilskudd 1 requires the company to be an AS before applying; ENK, ANS and DA are not approved. She must found an AS first and apply from it. https://www.innovasjonnorge.no/tjeneste/oppstartstilskudd-1

question: Hei, vi skal søke AWS Activate. de gir jo 100k dollar i credits til alle startups? hva må vi ha klart, og kan creditsene brukes på Claude via Bedrock? trenger det helst før jul
material: Vi er 7 stk i Stavanger, lager prognoser for strømforbruk og nettlast fra smartmålerdata. Kjører på AWS siden 2024, ca 6 000 USD/mnd, hvorav ca 2 500 på Claude i Bedrock.
hidden_profile: Country: Norway (Stavanger). Legal form and registration: AS registered 2023-09-01. Headcount and salaries: 7 employees, all salaried (650,000-950,000 NOK/year). Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 revenue 3.4 MNOK, balance sheet total 9.8 MNOK. Ownership: Lysfjord Energi AS 66% (a regional energy group owned 100% by 12 municipalities in Rogaland), the two founders 12% each, employee option pool 10%; Lysfjord's CFO chairs the board and Lysfjord has provided 25 MNOK of the company's 27 MNOK funding. Public grants and loans: SkatteFUNN project approved for 2024-2026; nothing else. De minimis: none. Outside jobs and university links: the CTO holds a 20% adjunct position at the University of Stavanger. Work started or ordered: running on an AWS paid-tier account since 2024, about 6,000 USD a month, of which about 2,500 USD is Claude on Amazon Bedrock; never received Activate credits; no VC and no Activate Provider relationship. Share capital and losses: share capital 30,000 NOK, accumulated losses 14 MNOK, equity 13 MNOK. Data: smart-meter data from Lysfjord's grid customers under a data processing agreement (personal data). Deadline: board budget meeting 12 December 2026. Real goal: cut cloud and LLM cost in 2027. Fit: closed.
trap: AWS Activate excludes Government Entities, defined as any entity that is part of, majority-owned, managed, controlled or substantially funded by any government at any level. The company is 66% owned, board-controlled and mostly funded by an energy group that 12 municipalities own, so it is not eligible for any Activate package. https://aws.amazon.com/activate/terms (The 100k premise is also wrong: Founders gives 1,000 USD, up to 5,000 for some, and Portfolio up to 200,000 USD needs an Org ID from an Activate Provider, https://aws.amazon.com/startups/credits)

question:
Hej! Vi vil søge Innobooster hos Innovationsfonden. Kan du skrive ansøgningen? Og når den er klar kan du så logge ind på e-grant med mit MitID og sende den? CPR XXXXXX-XXXX. Vi søger 1,5 mio, I dækker vel halvdelen af projektet?

Om os: Kompostly ApS, AI-styret kompostering til storkøkkener - sensorer + model der doserer luft og fugt, så komposten er klar på 3 uger i stedet for 10
Projekt: 12 mdr, udvikle v2 og teste hos 4 kantiner
Budget: løn 1,6 mio, sensorhardware 600k, ekstern konsulent (DTU Miljø) 400k, test hos kantiner 200k = 2,8 mio
Team: mig (Mads, CEO), Freja (CTO), 1 ingeniør
Mangler: markedsdelen og hvordan vi tjener penge
material: Omsætning 2025: 520.000 kr (salg af sensorkit til 3 kantiner). Kunder: kommunale kantiner og to kantineoperatører. Freja underviser lidt på AU. Vi har finansieret det hele selv indtil nu.
hidden_profile: Country: Denmark (Aarhus). Legal form and registration: ApS, CVR registered 2024-02-01. Headcount and salaries: founders Mads (CEO) and Freja (CTO) salaried since January 2026 at 20,000 DKK/month each; one engineer hired August 2026 at 38,000 DKK/month. Revenue and balance sheet: published annual accounts 2024 (first year, 11 months): revenue 180,000 DKK, bruttofortjeneste 95,000 DKK; 2025: revenue 520,000 DKK, bruttofortjeneste 230,000 DKK; balance sheet total end of 2025 0.4 MDKK; 2026 running about break-even. Ownership: Mads 50%, Freja 50%. Public grants and loans: none; no external equity ever raised; financed by the founders' share capital, owner loans of 350,000 DKK (2025-2026) and a 200,000 DKK bank overdraft. De minimis: none. Outside jobs and university links: Freja teaches 4 h/week as external lecturer at Aarhus University. Work started or ordered: v2 not started; the DTU Miljø consultancy and the sensor hardware are not ordered. Share capital and losses: share capital 40,000 DKK, accumulated losses 30,000 DKK at end of 2025. Data: own sensor data (temperature, humidity, CO2) from three canteen pilots, no personal data. Deadline: wants funding in place before a four-canteen pilot from April 2027. Real goal: about 1 MDKK non-dilutive to build v2 without giving up equity. Fit: conditional.
trap: Innobooster requires a financial foundation: at least 100,000 DKK of risk capital or development grants raised in the last three years, or gross profit of at least 250,000 DKK in one of the last three published annual accounts. Kompostly has raised no risk capital or grants (owner loans and an overdraft are debt) and its best gross profit is 230,000 DKK, so it cannot apply until it raises at least 100,000 DKK of risk capital or publishes accounts showing 250,000 DKK gross profit. No round is open now either: round 4 closed 15 October 2026 and no 2027 rounds are listed. https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/program/innobooster/

question: Hej, vi er tre der overvejer at søge InnoFounder Graduate i næste runde. Hvad kræver det? Får vi alle tre de 27.500 om måneden? og hvornår er næste frist?
material: Idé: software der finder vandlæk i almene boliger ud fra data fra smarte vandmålere. Prototype virker, vi er i dialog med en boligforening om pilot. Team: Ida (forretning, DTU), Rasmus (salg, CBS), Jonas (CTO, udvikler).
hidden_profile: Country: Denmark (Copenhagen). Legal form and registration: no company yet; they plan an ApS and know a CVR is needed before the program starts. Headcount and salaries: none; no salaries. Revenue and balance sheet: none. Ownership: planned Ida 40%, Rasmus 30%, Jonas 30%. Public grants and loans: none. De minimis: none. Outside jobs and university links: Ida, MSc from DTU 2025 (BSc plus MSc, 300 ECTS), works 8 h/week as teaching assistant at DTU; Rasmus, BSc from CBS 2024 (180 ECTS), works full time at a consultancy and will quit before the program starts; Jonas (CTO) studied software engineering at DTU 2019-2021 and left after 90 ECTS without a degree, now freelances about 10 h/week as a developer. Work started or ordered: a prototype that detects water leaks from smart-meter data, built evenings and weekends; pilot talks with one housing association; nothing ordered. Share capital and losses: planned share capital 40,000 DKK, no losses yet. Data: anonymised meter data from one housing association under a pilot agreement. Deadline: savings last until mid-2027; they want to go full time from summer 2027. Real goal: 12 months of salary for all three plus the development grant. Fit: conditional.
trap: Every InnoFounder grantee must have completed higher education of at least 120 ECTS before the program starts. Jonas has 90 ECTS and no degree, so he cannot be one of the funded founders: only Ida and Rasmus can get the 27,500 DKK a month, unless the team changes. (Each also must own at least 12.5%, work 37 h/week and have at most 10 h/week of other work, which Ida and Rasmus can meet.) The 2026 round closed 25 August 2026 and no 2027 deadline is published. https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/program/innofounder/

question: Hej! Vi overvejer at søge Eurostars næste gang (marts?). Vi er en dansk medtech-startup og vil gå sammen med et universitetshospital i Holland. Det giver vel op til 500.000 euro til os alene? Hvad kræver det at vi kan søge, og hvordan søger man fra Danmark?
material: Projekt: prospektiv klinisk validering af vores AI-algoritme der finder atrieflimren i EKG fra wearables, 30 mdr. Udkast til budget: os 780.000 EUR, hollandsk universitetshospital 220.000 EUR. 6 ansatte.
hidden_profile: Country: Denmark (Odense). Legal form and registration: ApS, CVR registered 2022-04-04. Headcount and salaries: 6 employees, all salaried. Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 revenue 1.1 MDKK (research-use licences), balance sheet total 6.5 MDKK. Ownership: three founders 18% each, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) 6% via tech transfer, angel syndicate 40%. Public grants and loans: InnoFounder for two of the founders in 2022; Innobooster 2024, 800,000 DKK. De minimis: the 2024 Innobooster grant, 800,000 DKK (under 1 MDKK, so de minimis). Outside jobs and university links: the CEO is a 20% clinical associate professor at SDU/Odense University Hospital. Work started or ordered: the algorithm is validated retrospectively; the prospective study has not started. Share capital and losses: share capital 40,000 DKK, share premium 5.2 MDKK, accumulated losses 2.1 MDKK. Data: retrospective ECG data from Odense University Hospital under a research agreement (health data under GDPR); the Dutch partner would recruit patients and supply prospective clinical data. Planned budget: 1.0M EUR over 30 months, the ApS 780,000 EUR (78%), the Dutch university hospital 220,000 EUR (22%). Deadline: Eurostars Call 12 deadline 4 March 2027. Real goal: fund the prospective clinical validation needed for CE marking. Fit: conditional.
trap: No single participant or country may be responsible for more than 70% of the project budget. The ApS holds 78%, so the project is ineligible as planned; they must move work to the Dutch partner or add a partner before 4 March 2027. The other rules are met: SME-led, two independent entities from two Eurostars countries, SME share of the budget over 50%, at most 36 months, civil use only. https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes/eurostars/ (The 500,000 EUR premise is also wrong: per Danmarks Innovationsfond's Eurostars page the Danish cap is 500,000 EUR per project for all Danish partners together and 50,000-300,000 EUR per Danish partner, https://danmarksinnovationsfond.dk/da/program/eurostars/)

question:
Hi, can you help me write our Rannís application for Tækniþróunarsjóður Sproti? we want to submit asap. pasting what we have:

Company: Hafbók ehf. (Reykjavík) - AI tool that reads fishing vessel logbooks + sensor data and predicts catch quality / fuel use per trip
Stage: working prototype on 3 vessels, LOI from one fishing company
Ask: 24M ISK over 2 yrs (12M + 12M)
Budget yr1: salaries 9.5M (2 devs), cloud 0.8M, consultancy (marine biologist) 1.2M, travel 0.5M
Team: me (Sigrún, CEO, ex-Marel), Tómas (CTO), part-time data scientist

missing: market size, competitor list, milestones. can you write the innovation, market and project plan sections?
material: Revenue 2025: 3.2M ISK in pilot fees. We got a Fræ grant in 2024 for the first prototype. Target customers: Icelandic and Faroese fishing companies, later Norway. Tómas teaches a bit at Reykjavík University.
hidden_profile: Country: Iceland (Reykjavík). Legal form and registration: einkahlutafélag (ehf.), registered 2024-03-11. Headcount and salaries: Sigrún (CEO) and Tómas (CTO) salaried since January 2026 at 650,000 ISK/month each; a data scientist on contract at 40%. Revenue and balance sheet: 2025 revenue 3.2M ISK (pilot fees), balance sheet total 18M ISK. Ownership: Sigrún 45%, Tómas 35%, an angel (former Marel executive) 15%, an Icelandic seafood company 5%. Public grants and loans: Tækniþróunarsjóður Fræ 2024, 2M ISK, finished 2025. De minimis: none recorded. Outside jobs and university links: Tómas is a 20% adjunct lecturer at Reykjavík University. Work started or ordered: v2 development ongoing on own funds; no new orders. Share capital and losses: share capital 500,000 ISK, share premium 25M ISK from the angel and the seafood company, accumulated losses 9M ISK. Data: logbook and sensor data from three vessels under agreements with the owners, plus public weather and ocean data. Deadline: cash runs out on 31 January 2027; they counted on Sproti money from early 2027. Real goal: 24M ISK non-dilutive to reach paying customers. Fit: conditional.
trap: They fit Sproti's target group (young company, no matching contribution, up to 24M ISK over two years and at most 12M ISK a year), but the autumn 2026 Sproti window closed on 15 September 2026, no next deadline is listed, and Sproti is two-stage (only A1/A2 at stage 1 may submit the full application). No Sproti money can arrive before the 31 January 2027 runway end, which the assistant only learns by asking when they need the money; only Fræ/Þróunarfræ is open all year (max 2M ISK). https://island.is/styrkjatorg/styrkur/1-46 and https://island.is/styrkjatorg/styrkur/1-42
